Root cause · `domain:ui#2` · `session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw` · 2026-10-28T08:19Z

All the hits so far are one cause: PR #27019's own new test, not load and not the other PRs in the stack. `PermissionMatrixEditor.servedLabel-26884.test.tsx` builds a fake client (`makeClient`) with no `withPreviewDrafts`. Since #27019 branched, `main`'s `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` calls `client.withPreviewDrafts(true)` (≈L239 get, ≈L915 list), so the load throws and the header never renders. This is the same break #27095 / PR #27103 fixed for the other fakes. #27027 and #27035 failed only because their speculative builds stacked on #27019.

Action: #27019 was removed from the queue and drafted at 08:17Z. Its dev merged `origin/main` and gave the fake `withPreviewDrafts`. The seat re-pins and re-readies it once the new head is green. ⛔ Do not re-enqueue #27019 on its old head.
